steps.body: Teen numbers hide a ten. 13 is 1 ten and 3 ones — 'thir-TEEN' means three and ten.
steps.narration: Teen numbers hide a ten. Thirteen is one ten and three ones — thirteen means three and ten.

commonBuilds.feedback: That builds 31 — the flip! 13 has ONE ten and 3 ones.
13 loose cubes works, but trade ten of them for a rod: 1 ten, 3 ones.

widget.missFeedback: Thir-TEEN = 3 and a ten: 1 rod, 3 cubes.

predict.prompt: Building 13 — will it use more rods or more loose cubes?
predict.reveal: 13 is one rod and three cubes — the ones outnumber the tens here, even though the 1 comes first in the number.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents teens.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for teens must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines teens.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: 13 is 1 ten 3 ones; 31 is 3 tens 1 one. The order of digits changes the number.
Thirteen and thirty-one use the same digits in different places — 13 is much smaller.

options.feedback: 31 is 3 tens and 1 one — the flip. ONE ten and 3 ones is 13.
103 has a hundred in it. 1 ten and 3 ones is just 13.

steps.body: Careful: 13 and 31 flip the digits. 13 = 1 ten 3 ones. 31 = 3 tens 1 one.
steps.narration: Careful: thirteen and thirty-one flip the digits. Thirteen is one ten, three ones. Thirty-one is three tens, one one.

widget.prompt: Now build 31 with ten-rods and one-cubes.

commonBuilds.feedback: That builds 13 — the teen! 31 has THREE tens and 1 one.

explanationVariants: Six-TEEN means six and a ten: 1 ten, 6 ones = 16.
16 is a teen: one ten plus 6 ones.

widget.prompt: What numeral is 1 ten and 6 ones?

commonErrors.feedback: That flipped it into 6 tens. ONE ten and 6 ones is 16.
That added 1 + 6. The ten is worth ten: 10 + 6 = 16.

explanationVariants: 'Fourteen' means four and ten: 14, with the 1 ten written first.

options.feedback: 41 is 'forty-one' — 4 tens. FourTEEN is 1 ten and 4 ones: 14.
Yes — four-TEEN is 4 and a ten: 14.
40 is 'forty' — 4 tens and no ones. Fourteen is 14.

explanationVariants: Eigh-TEEN is 8 and a ten: 18. The flip, 81, is eighty-one — 8 tens.
18 = 1 ten 8 ones; 81 = 8 tens 1 one. The teen is the small one.

commonErrors.feedback: 81 is eighty-one — 8 tens. EighTEEN is 1 ten and 8 ones: 18.
80 is eighty. The '-teen' means one ten plus 8: 18.

takeaways: A teen is 1 ten plus some ones.
13 and 31 are flips — watch the order.

concept.body: Slow it down. Fif-TEEN means five and ten. So 15 is 1 ten and 5 ones.
concept.narration: Fifteen means five and ten. So fifteen is one ten and five ones.

widget.prompt: What numeral is 1 ten and 5 ones?

commonErrors.feedback: That flipped into 5 tens. ONE ten and 5 ones is 15.
That added 1 + 5. The ten is worth ten: 10 + 5 = 15.
